reason: V3 — Win-axis diversification. cycle_2e758cd9442f round 2 won +5pp on a task_intent rewrite; round 3 reverted to param variants and hit 0%. Force the population to exploit a freshly-winning axis before exploring elsewhere.
brief: Round-over-round axis policy: inspect round_history. If the last round's best candidate beat its parent by mutating axis X (e.g., persona, task_intent, instruction, a specific node param), at least 50% of this round's variants must mutate axis X — each in a distinct direction (different persona framings, different task_intent phrasings, etc.). The remaining variants may explore unrelated axes. Do not abandon a winning axis with one round's worth of evidence.
